name: Kiro CLI
desc: Kiro's agentic coding agents in the terminal, sharing specs with the IDE.
desc_zh: 把 Kiro 的智能体编程能力带进终端，规格与 IDE 共用。
solves: Production debugging happens over SSH, where the IDE agent is not; Kiro CLI puts the same agents in that shell.
solves_zh: 线上排障都在 SSH 里进行，IDE 智能体用不上；Kiro CLI 把同一批智能体放进那个终端。
best_for: You are SSH'd into a server at 2 a.m. tracing an error and want the agent beside your shell history.
best_for_zh: 凌晨两点 SSH 上服务器查错误，希望智能体就守在命令历史旁边时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed and product directory）。 Missing from the ledger: the aws vendor has only Kiro. Kiro CLI is a separate surface from Kiro IDE, not a version of it. V3 became the default experience on 2026-10-13. 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-kiro-cli/
